pla-01.prompt: Flat two-dimensional educational illustration. Simple closed shapes, confident dark outlines, solid uniform fill colors. No gradients, shading, perspective rendering effects or texture. The verb TO LOVE: two people who love each other share a tender affectionate hug, visible reciprocal embrace and warm facial expressions. A quiet sincere moment, not a formal greeting. Full figures including shoes well within generous white margins. No floating hearts, icons, text, caption or props. Plain clothes and smooth simple shoes. A father and child hug one another warmly, father kneeling to the child's height, both smiling with eyes closed. Clear reciprocal embrace. Single square CACE vocabulary image. Pure white background, show every subject and essential prop whole inside the middle two thirds of the canvas. IMPORTANT: zoom the composition OUT. Leave roughly ONE SIXTH of canvas width on both the left and right and generous WHITE space above and below. No object or person's extremity touches an edge. No border. Absolutely no text, lettering, digits, writing or pseudo-writing, labels, watermarks, brand marks, logos or emblems anywhere. One clear composition.
